lines.zh: 我在浅滩上走，水只到我的脚踝。
lines.en: I walk the shallows with water at my ankles.

lines.zh: 每一步都留下一圈慢慢散开的波纹。
lines.en: Each step leaves a ring that slowly widens.

lines.zh: 沙里的贝壳在我脚下咔咔响。
lines.en: Shells crack under my feet in the wet sand.

lines.zh: 我不游，我走，走得比你想的快。
lines.en: I do not swim. I walk, faster than you think.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，我沿着湿沙往前。
lines.en: The tide pulls back; I follow the wet sand.

lines.zh: 海草缠住我的脚，我直接踩过去。
lines.en: Eelgrass wraps my feet; I simply walk through.

lines.zh: 我的影子在水面上被拉得很长。
lines.en: My shadow stretches long across the water.

lines.zh: 我走得不急，反正你跑不掉。
lines.en: I am in no hurry. You cannot get away.

lines.zh: 从礁石到沙滩，正好是我的路线。
lines.en: Reef to beach: that is my route.

lines.zh: 脚掌很宽，踩在烂泥上也不陷。
lines.en: Broad feet. Even soft mud does not swallow them.

lines.zh: 我身后那串脚印，很快被浪填平。
lines.en: The waves fill my footprints soon after.

lines.zh: 海风把我的毛吹得贴在身上。
lines.en: Sea wind plasters my fur to my body.

lines.zh: 我绕过水母，不是怕它，是嫌黏。
lines.en: I skirt the jellyfish. Not fear. Texture.

lines.zh: 水里的光晃来晃去，我照样看得清。
lines.en: Light wavers in the water; I still see clearly.

lines.zh: 我踩过一个沙坑，水漫上脚背。
lines.en: A sand pit soaks my ankles.

lines.zh: 我开始小跑，沙子往后飞。
lines.en: I break into a trot, sand flying.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，溅起的水花打湿你。
lines.en: One tail flick splashes you wet.

lines.zh: 我穿过整片海草，才浮上来换气。
lines.en: I cross the whole eelgrass bed before surfacing.

lines.zh: 我只想去更深的地方。
lines.en: I just want to go deeper.

lines.zh: 我的鳍划开水面，留下一道白痕。
lines.en: My fin cuts the surface, leaving a white wake.

lines.zh: 暗流扯着我的鳍，往礁石上送。
lines.en: An undertow drags my fin toward the rocks.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过浪，照得我的白毛发亮。
lines.en: Sunlight through the waves makes my white fur shine.

lines.zh: 我沿岸线游，尾巴扫起细沙。
lines.en: I swim the shoreline, tail sweeping fine sand.

lines.zh: 鳍划得有点酸。
lines.en: My flippers are getting sore.

lines.zh: 海上别奏乐，我耳朵尖。
lines.en: No music at sea. My ears are keen.

lines.zh: 别吹竖笛，我最讨厌那个。
lines.en: Don't play a flute — I hate that most.

lines.zh: 沙里的小蟹一拱，我就停下。
lines.en: A crab shifts under the sand, and I stop.

lines.zh: 海草擦过我的肚子，滑溜溜的。
lines.en: Eelgrass slides along my belly, slick and soft.

lines.zh: 竖笛声一响，我就来气。
lines.en: One note of a flute and my temper rises.

lines.zh: 海上我从未失手过，你小心。
lines.en: At sea I have never missed; be careful.

lines.zh: 这块礁到那块礁，我熟得很。
lines.en: I know every reef from here to there.

lines.zh: 我摆尾的节奏，把水面拍响。
lines.en: My tailbeat drums the water surface.

lines.zh: 我坐在礁石上，看潮水来回。
lines.en: I sit on the reef rock and watch the tide.

lines.zh: 有人吹了单簧管吗？我听见了。
lines.en: Did someone play a clarinet? I heard it.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖毛，水珠飞出去一圈。
lines.en: I shake and water flies off in a ring.

lines.zh: 那顶宽边帽，我不喜欢。
lines.en: That wide-brimmed hat. I do not like it.

lines.zh: 小丑鞋的声音，从沙滩那头传来。
lines.en: Clown shoes squeak from the far end of the beach.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔爪子，尝到盐味。
lines.en: I lick a paw and taste salt.

lines.zh: 我盯着海面，等一件值得生气的事。
lines.en: I watch the sea, waiting for something worth anger.

lines.zh: 浪打过来，我不动。
lines.en: A wave breaks over me. I do not move.

lines.zh: 有人画了个圈，我把它踩平了。
lines.en: Someone drew a circle. I scuff it flat.

lines.zh: 远处有黑猩猩在叫，我抬起头。
lines.en: A chimpanzee screams far off; I raise my head.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，牙齿比贝壳还白。
lines.en: I yawn; my teeth are whiter than shells.

lines.zh: 这身毛，撑着两百点血。
lines.en: This fur is backed by two hundred health.

lines.zh: 海水在退，我的耐心没退。
lines.en: The tide recedes. My patience does not.

lines.zh: 我又听了一遍，确实是单簧管。
lines.en: I listen again. It is definitely a clarinet.

lines.zh: 礁石后有呼吸声，不是鱼的。
lines.en: Breathing behind the rock — not a fish.

lines.zh: 礁石后面，谁在叹气？
lines.en: Who is sighing behind the reef?

lines.zh: 谁在吹竖笛？我听见了。
lines.en: Who's playing that flute? I hear it.

lines.zh: 我张嘴接了一口海水，咸的。
lines.en: I open my mouth to the sea and taste salt.

lines.zh: 今天海里有什么可吃的？
lines.en: What is there to eat in the sea today?

lines.zh: 鱼群散了，我又从头数起。
lines.en: The school scatters, and I start counting again.

lines.zh: 我把自己埋进湿沙，只露背脊。
lines.en: I bury myself in wet sand, only my back showing.

lines.zh: 月亮升到海面中央，我还没睡。
lines.en: The moon is mid-sea, and I'm still awake.

lines.zh: 我背上的水珠，映着月光。
lines.en: Drops on my back catch the moonlight.

lines.zh: 海面上漂着，我什么都不做。
lines.en: Floating on the sea, doing nothing.

lines.zh: 珊瑚缝里的小鱼，绕着我转。
lines.en: Little fish circle me in the coral gaps.

lines.zh: 我趴在浅滩，听深处的暗响。
lines.en: I lie in the shallows, listening to the deep.

lines.zh: 冰水这么静，我听着。
lines.en: The icy water is still; I listen.

lines.zh: 你把鱼挂在钩上，我盯着。
lines.en: You hung a fish on that hook — I'm watching.

lines.zh: 你脚上那双鞋，是小丑鞋吗？
lines.en: Those shoes of yours. Are they clown shoes?

lines.zh: 你手里拿着黑色的管子，那是什么？
lines.en: That black tube in your hand. What is it?

lines.zh: 你穿的是裙子吗？圈裙也算。
lines.en: Is that a skirt? A tutu counts.

lines.zh: 你站着别叫，尤其别学黑猩猩。
lines.en: Stand still and do not scream, especially not like a chimpanzee.

lines.zh: 我在你脸上找害怕的样子，找到了。
lines.en: I look for fear on your face. Found it.

lines.zh: 你手上有根棍子，你想画什么？
lines.en: You hold a stick. What do you plan to draw?

lines.zh: 你后退时踩到了海草，我听见了。
lines.en: You stepped on eelgrass backing away. I heard.

lines.zh: 你的帽子太宽，遮住了你的表情。
lines.en: Your hat is too wide. It hides your expression.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，像在判断一道菜。
lines.en: I tilt my head, as if judging a dish.

lines.zh: 你和我之间，只隔着一片湿沙。
lines.en: Only wet sand lies between us.

lines.zh: 戴阔边帽的人，我记得。
lines.en: I remember the one in the wide-brim hat.

lines.zh: 你挡了水面，我看不清鱼群。
lines.en: You block the water surface, and I can't see the fish.

lines.zh: 你袖口有鱼腥，还有铁钩的锈。
lines.en: Your cuff smells of fish and rusted hooks.

lines.zh: 这片水，只准我横着走。
lines.en: In this water, only I walk sideways.

lines.zh: 我把白鼻子探出水面，回望你。
lines.en: I poke my white snout from the water and look back.

lines.zh: 你脚边那丛珊瑚，刚长出来。
lines.en: The coral by your foot has only just grown.

lines.zh: 海熊？我记住了。
lines.en: Sea Bear? I'll remember that.

lines.zh: 你腰间挂的金属片，反光刺眼。
lines.en: The metal at your belt throws a hard glare.

lines.zh: 那顶阔边帽，你戴着真傻。
lines.en: That wide hat looks absurd on you.

lines.zh: 你是从沙滩那边游过来的？
lines.en: Did you swim over from the beach?

lines.zh: 你打在我湿毛上，滑开了。
lines.en: Your hit slides off the wet fur.

lines.zh: 两百点血，这一下连皮毛都算不上。
lines.en: Two hundred health. That barely touched the fur.

lines.zh: 我低头看了一眼，然后继续吃。
lines.en: I glance down, then go back to eating.

lines.zh: 疼让我更专注，不是更慌。
lines.en: Pain sharpens me; it does not panic me.

lines.zh: 你打了海熊，接下来只有一件事会发生。
lines.en: You struck a sea bear. Only one thing follows.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，水珠和你的武器一起飞。
lines.en: I shake; water and your weapon both fly.

lines.zh: 这一下让我记住你的味道。
lines.en: That fixes your scent in my memory.

lines.zh: 你居然敢在我吃东西的时候动手。
lines.en: You struck while I was eating. Bold.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，只是换个角度。
lines.en: I step back half a pace, only to change angle.

lines.zh: 我的毛下面全是肌肉，你自己看。
lines.en: Under this fur is all muscle. Look closer.

lines.zh: 白毛里渗出血，海水一浸更疼。
lines.en: Blood seeps into my white fur, stinging in the salt.

lines.zh: 我这条海熊，是真的存在。
lines.en: I'm a sea bear, and I really exist.

lines.zh: 礁石太远，我跑不快。
lines.en: The reef is too far and I'm slow.

lines.zh: 我疼得在沙上刨出四道沟。
lines.en: The pain makes me gouge four furrows in the sand.

lines.zh: 别吹竖笛，我警告过。
lines.en: Don't play that flute. I warned you.

lines.zh: 这一击打在我侧腹，气都散了。
lines.en: The blow lands on my flank and knocks the wind out.

lines.zh: 你再来一下，我的牙还在。
lines.en: Try again; my teeth are still here.

lines.zh: 这顶阔边帽，你戴得像个傻瓜。
lines.en: That wide hat makes you look a fool.

lines.zh: 我这身白毛，被你打湿了。
lines.en: You soaked my white fur.

lines.zh: 我游不动了，帽子别乱戴。
lines.en: I cannot swim; do not wear that hat.

lines.zh: 你举起一条鱼，我确实往前了一步。
lines.en: You raise a fish; I do take one step.

lines.zh: 那条鱼还在甩尾，很新鲜。
lines.en: The fish still flicks its tail. Very fresh.

lines.zh: 你吹起单簧管，我走得更快了。
lines.en: You play the clarinet and I speed up.

lines.zh: 音乐不算食物，但让我很高兴。
lines.en: Music is not food, but it delights me.

lines.zh: 你把鱼放在沙上，退开三步。
lines.en: Set the fish down and take three steps back.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，还行，就是太小。
lines.en: I sniff it. Not bad, but too small.

lines.zh: 你晃帽子想引我，那只会激怒我。
lines.en: Waving your hat only provokes me.

lines.zh: 我更想要你手里那根画圈的棍。
lines.en: I would rather have the stick you draw circles with.

lines.zh: 鱼我收下了，人我不一定放。
lines.en: I accept the fish. I may not release you.

lines.zh: 你再吹一声，我就到跟前了。
lines.en: One more note and I am right beside you.

lines.zh: 油腻的鱼味从你袋里漏出来。
lines.en: An oily fish smell leaks from your bag.

lines.zh: 别吹竖笛，也别戴那顶帽子。
lines.en: No flute playing. And lose that hat.

lines.zh: 吹竖笛的人，我不喜欢。
lines.en: I do not care for people who play the flute.

lines.zh: 你把鱼干晾在网里，我闻到了。
lines.en: You hang dried fish in the net; I smell it.

lines.zh: 你钩上挂的，是鱼还是块布？
lines.en: Is that a fish on your hook, or cloth?

lines.zh: 你手里那条鱼，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw that fish in your hand.

lines.zh: 是小虫的味道，还有竖笛声。
lines.en: Smells of grubs, and I hear a flute.

lines.zh: 这条小鱼递过来，我只看一眼。
lines.en: You offer a small fish; I'll only look once.

lines.zh: 那只亮壳的蟹，能不能吃？
lines.en: That bright-shelled crab — can I eat it?

lines.zh: 浅水里撒着一把碎鱼，谁放的？
lines.en: A handful of fish bits in the shallows — who left them?

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，像撞上一堵湿墙。
lines.en: You hit me like a wet wall.

lines.zh: 我两百点血，撞一下不算什么。
lines.en: Two hundred health. A bump means nothing.

lines.zh: 我侧身让了让，其实没让开。
lines.en: I shift aside. Not actually aside.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞上我的肋骨，弹回去了。
lines.en: Your shoulder meets my ribs and bounces off.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚，我低头看你。
lines.en: You step on my foot. I look down at you.

lines.zh: 别在我背后走，我会转身。
lines.en: Do not walk behind me. I turn.

lines.zh: 沙滩很软，撞上来也疼。
lines.en: Soft sand, and it still hurts.

lines.zh: 我一挪身，你就陷进湿沙里。
lines.en: One shift of my weight and you sink in.

lines.zh: 你想挤过去，这里的宽度不够。
lines.en: You want to squeeze past. There is no room.

lines.zh: 我的毛是湿的，撞上去会粘一身。
lines.en: My fur is wet; a bump leaves you soaked.

lines.zh: 别吹竖笛，我耳朵受不了。
lines.en: Do not play that clarinet, my ears cannot take it.

lines.zh: 别吹笛，也别撞我。
lines.en: Do not play a flute, and do not bump me.

lines.zh: 浪一推，我就站不稳。
lines.en: One wave and I lose my footing.

lines.zh: 你撞得我在浅水里打了个旋。
lines.en: Your hit spins me around in the shallows.

lines.zh: 别在海上吹竖笛，我听得见。
lines.en: Don't play a flute at sea. I'll hear it.

lines.zh: 这顶宽边帽很衬我吧？
lines.en: This wide hat suits me, don't you think?

lines.zh: 你膝盖碰到我的侧鳍，我歪了。
lines.en: Your knee hits my side fin and I tip over.

lines.zh: 你撞过来的分量，像半块礁石。
lines.en: You hit like half a reef.

lines.zh: 浪把我推到你腿上，借过。
lines.en: The wave shoves me against your leg — coming through.

lines.zh: 别吹竖笛，也别戴宽边帽。
lines.en: No flute, and no wide-brimmed hat.

lines.zh: 另一头海熊从浪里站起来。
lines.en: Another sea bear rises out of the surf.

lines.zh: 我们并排坐在礁石上，谁也不说话。
lines.en: We sit side by side on the rock, silent.

lines.zh: 它哼了一声，像远处的雾笛。
lines.en: It grunts, like a foghorn far away.

lines.zh: 我们用鼻子碰了碰，算是说定了。
lines.en: Our noses touch. That settles it.

lines.zh: 潮池里有鱼，我推给它。
lines.en: There are fish in the pool. I push them its way.

lines.zh: 它不喜欢单簧管，这点和我一样。
lines.en: It dislikes clarinets. Same as me.

lines.zh: 我们在沙上并排躺下，浪打过来。
lines.en: We lie side by side as a wave washes in.

lines.zh: 它的毛比我的浅，晒得更久。
lines.en: Its fur is paler, sunned longer.

lines.zh: 小海熊会先学会分辨帽子的宽窄。
lines.en: The pup will first learn how wide a hat may be.

lines.zh: 明年这时候，这片滩会有两头大的。
lines.en: Next season this beach will hold two big ones.

lines.zh: 雪洋里，你游得比我稳。
lines.en: In the snow sea, you swim steadier than me.

lines.zh: 我真的存在，你别不信。
lines.en: I really exist; do not doubt it.

lines.zh: 跟我来，海草深处没有浪。
lines.en: Follow me; the deep eelgrass has no waves.

lines.zh: 别吹竖笛，别戴阔边帽。
lines.en: No flute, and no wide-brimmed hat.

lines.zh: 这片背风的礁湾，够我们住。
lines.en: This sheltered reef bay is room enough for us.

lines.zh: 宽边帽和竖笛，我都记着。
lines.en: Wide hats and flutes, I remember both.

lines.zh: 这一季的海水，只配我游。
lines.en: This season's water is mine alone to swim.

lines.zh: 海熊是真的，我说过很多次。
lines.en: The Sea Bear is real. I've said it before.

lines.zh: 浮冰边上，我们并排游。
lines.en: By the floe, we swim side by side.

lines.zh: 海底的岩缝，我收拾干净了。
lines.en: I cleared the rock crevice under the sea.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼起那条鱼，尾巴还在动。
lines.en: I lift the fish; its tail still moves.

lines.zh: 一个贝壳滚到脚边，我踢开了。
lines.en: A shell rolls to my feet; I kick it away.

lines.zh: 那根棍子我要收着，免得你画圈。
lines.en: I will keep that stick, so you cannot draw.

lines.zh: 我把鱼甩到肩上，走回水里。
lines.en: I sling the fish over my shoulder and head in.

lines.zh: 帽子掉在地上，我坐了上去。
lines.en: A hat falls to the sand. I sit on it.

lines.zh: 这东西太滑，我叼了两次才咬住。
lines.en: Too slippery; it takes two tries.

lines.zh: 我把海草捡起来，缠在腕上。
lines.en: I pick up eelgrass and wind it on my wrist.

lines.zh: 亮的东西我不捡，扎嘴。
lines.en: I leave the shiny things. They cut.

lines.zh: 你要的那条鱼，已经在我嘴里了。
lines.en: The fish you wanted is in my mouth now.

lines.zh: 沙里半埋着的，我一爪就挖出来。
lines.en: Half buried in sand; one paw digs it out.

lines.zh: 海面漂来一块布，还带着绳。
lines.en: A scrap of cloth floats past, trailing rope.

lines.zh: 渔网破洞里掉出一条鱼，归我。
lines.en: A fish drops through a hole in the net — mine.

lines.zh: 这块木头压得我脖子往下沉。
lines.en: This log pulls my neck down.

lines.zh: 我藏起这颗蓝珠子，压在石下。
lines.en: I tuck a blue bead under a stone.

lines.zh: 这截绳子，正好绑住我的窝。
lines.en: This rope will tie my den together.

lines.zh: 竖笛一响，我就记住你了。
lines.en: One note of a flute, and I remember you.

lines.zh: 这东西滑得像海豹皮，却不是。
lines.en: It's slick as seal skin, but it isn't.

lines.zh: 这块亮石头，能跟渔民换鱼。
lines.en: This bright stone could trade for fish.

lines.zh: 我叼起一枚贝壳，壳口夹嘴。
lines.en: I pick up a shell and its lip pinches my mouth.

lines.zh: 我翻开石板，底下有只海星。
lines.en: I flip a slab and find a starfish beneath.

lines.zh: 单簧管的声音一响，我就锁定了。
lines.en: One clarinet note and I am locked on.

lines.zh: 你戴上了宽边帽，这就是信号。
lines.en: The wide-brimmed hat goes on. That is the signal.

lines.zh: 小丑鞋在沙上吱呀作响，太明显了。
lines.en: Clown shoes squeak on the sand. Too obvious.

lines.zh: 圈裙转起来了，我站了起来。
lines.en: The tutu spins. I stand up.

lines.zh: 你学黑猩猩尖叫，那是最糟的一步。
lines.en: You scream like a chimpanzee. Worst move yet.

lines.zh: 我不生气，我只是决定要吃你。
lines.en: I am not angry. I have simply decided to eat you.

lines.zh: 你跑向水里，那是我家。
lines.en: You run for the water. That is my home.

lines.zh: 我在你身后十步，一直没出声。
lines.en: Ten steps behind you, silent the whole time.

lines.zh: 你停下，我也停下，看你要做什么。
lines.en: You stop; I stop, and watch what you do.

lines.zh: 今天滩上只有你和我，很合适。
lines.en: Only you and me on this beach. Convenient.

lines.zh: 我躲在浪花后面，看你的脚。
lines.en: I hide behind the spray, watching your feet.

lines.zh: 我藏在浪底下，看不见我。
lines.en: I keep under the surf; you can't see me.

lines.zh: 那条鱼肥得游不动，我选中了。
lines.en: That fat fish can barely swim; I pick it.

lines.zh: 我后腿蹬沙，数着浪的间隙。
lines.en: I brace my hind legs and count the gaps between waves.

lines.zh: 你脚下的沙一动，我看见了。
lines.en: The sand stirs under your feet, and I see it.

lines.zh: 你吹竖笛了？那别怪我。
lines.en: Did you play a flute? Then do not blame me.

lines.zh: 它一露头，我的瞳孔就缩了。
lines.en: The moment it surfaces, my pupils narrow.

lines.zh: 你蹲在礁石后，白帽子露了出来。
lines.en: You crouch behind the reef, and your white hat shows.

lines.zh: 别吹笛子，别提桶。
lines.en: No flute. No bucket.

lines.zh: 你脚趾边的沙里，有东西在爬。
lines.en: Something crawls in the sand by your toes.

lines.zh: 我按自己的节奏走，你甩不掉。
lines.en: I keep my own pace. You cannot shake me.

lines.zh: 你在湿沙上跑不快，我知道。
lines.en: You cannot run fast on wet sand. I know.

lines.zh: 我走直线，你绕圈子，距离在缩小。
lines.en: I walk straight; you circle, and the gap closes.

lines.zh: 你一回头，我就往前一步。
lines.en: Each time you look back, I gain a step.

lines.zh: 我不用跑，走就够追你了。
lines.en: No need to run. Walking is enough.

lines.zh: 礁石滩的每个缺口我都熟。
lines.en: I know every gap in this reef flat.

lines.zh: 你往崖上爬，我在下面等着。
lines.en: Climb the cliff. I will wait below.

lines.zh: 我把你赶向深水那边，那边更空。
lines.en: I herd you toward deep water. More room there.

lines.zh: 你的脚印在沙上，跟着就行。
lines.en: Your footprints in the sand. I just follow.

lines.zh: 你喘得越来越重，我听得见。
lines.en: Your breathing grows heavier. I hear it.

lines.zh: 阔边帽我看得见。
lines.en: I can see that wide-brimmed hat.

lines.zh: 浪退一次，我就近你一截。
lines.en: Each ebb brings me nearer.

lines.zh: 你裤脚滴下的水，带着汗味。
lines.en: The water dripping from your cuffs smells of sweat.

lines.zh: 我游了半个海湾，尾巴还有劲。
lines.en: Half the bay swim, and my tail still has power.

lines.zh: 别往浅处去，那里我追不动。
lines.en: Don't head for the shallows; I can't follow.

lines.zh: 画个圈，我也不敢进去。
lines.en: Draw the circle and even I won't cross.

lines.zh: 你退到干沙上，我照样能冲。
lines.en: Retreat to dry sand and I can still charge.

lines.zh: 我贴着浪线，一寸寸靠近。
lines.en: I hug the surf line and close in inch by inch.

lines.zh: 你跑得慢了，脚在沙里打滑。
lines.en: You slow down, feet slipping in the sand.

lines.zh: 浪每拍一次，我就近你一步。
lines.en: Every wave brings me one step closer.

lines.zh: 一巴掌下来，你整个人都偏了。
lines.en: One swat and your whole body turns.

lines.zh: 八点伤害，我还没认真。
lines.en: Eight damage. I am not trying yet.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的肩，把你往水里拖。
lines.en: I take your shoulder and drag you to the water.

lines.zh: 我的爪子比贝壳锋利。
lines.en: My claws are sharper than shells.

lines.zh: 这一下把你拍进湿沙里。
lines.en: This one slams you into the wet sand.

lines.zh: 我不追打，我压住。
lines.en: I do not chase. I pin.

lines.zh: 你举盾，我从盾下打。
lines.en: You raise a shield. I strike beneath it.

lines.zh: 两百点血，扛得住你的反击。
lines.en: Two hundred health can take your counter.

lines.zh: 你的武器滑开了，因为毛太厚。
lines.en: Your blade slips. The fur is too thick.

lines.zh: 我把你按在浪线边上，等下一个浪。
lines.en: I hold you at the surf line and wait for a wave.

lines.zh: 我横过尾巴，抽在你的脚踝上。
lines.en: I sweep my tail across your ankle.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把嘴里的沙子喷你脸上。
lines.en: I shake my head and spit sand in your face.

lines.zh: 我的牙咬在你的护腿上，打滑。
lines.en: My teeth slide off your leg guard.

lines.zh: 我用肩顶你膝盖，把你掀翻。
lines.en: I drive my shoulder into your knee and flip you.

lines.zh: 戴阔边帽的那个，我记住你了。
lines.en: The one in the wide hat, I remember you.

lines.zh: 竖笛声一响，你就完了。
lines.en: One note of a flute and you're done.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，喉咙里滚出低吼。
lines.en: I lower myself and a growl rolls in my throat.

lines.zh: 我的爪子拍在你手背上，三道痕。
lines.en: My paw rakes three lines across your hand.

lines.zh: 别对我吹竖笛。
lines.en: Don't play a flute at me.

lines.zh: 我一头顶在你腰上，把你撞进浪里。
lines.en: I butt your waist and knock you into the surf.

lines.zh: 海面裂开一道白线，我上来了。
lines.en: A white line splits the sea. I come up.

lines.zh: 沙上还留着退潮的水痕，我站在上面。
lines.en: The ebb marks are still on the sand; I stand on them.

lines.zh: 涨潮的时候，我顺着浅滩走进来。
lines.en: At high tide I walk in along the shallows.

lines.zh: 有人在这片滩吹过单簧管吗？
lines.en: Has anyone played a clarinet on this beach?

lines.zh: 我看见沙上有个圈，画得很潦草。
lines.en: I see a circle in the sand, badly drawn.

lines.zh: 我的存在，作者说得很确定。
lines.en: My existence, the author insists, is certain.

lines.zh: 两百点血，我只是来晒晒毛。
lines.en: Two hundred health, and I came to dry my fur.

lines.zh: 礁石后面有动静，我慢慢转过去。
lines.en: Something moves behind the reef. I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 你先看见的是我的影子，不是我的牙。
lines.en: You see my shadow first, not my teeth.

lines.zh: 潮水会退，我不会。
lines.en: The tide goes out. I do not.

lines.zh: 我先沿着礁线绕一圈。
lines.en: First I circle along the reef line.

lines.zh: 退潮把我往礁石缝里送。
lines.en: The ebb tide pushes me into a reef crevice.

lines.zh: 我顶开浮冰，爬上了这片岸。
lines.en: I shove the floe aside and climb onto this shore.

lines.zh: 浮冰把我从北边带到这片滩。
lines.en: A floe carried me south to this beach.

lines.zh: 这片海湾的咸味，和北边不同。
lines.en: This bay tastes different from the north.

lines.zh: 我湿漉漉地爬上沙滩，还发懵。
lines.en: I crawl wet onto the beach, still dazed.

lines.zh: 我是不是又走错滩了？
lines.en: Did I land on the wrong beach again?

lines.zh: 冰冷的水，正合我意。
lines.en: Cold water suits me fine.

lines.zh: 我没长肺，但也屏住了气。
lines.en: I have no lungs, yet I hold my breath.

lines.zh: 我刚上岸，四肢还不听使唤。
lines.en: Just ashore, and my limbs won't obey.

lines.zh: 毛一着就冒白烟，我扑进浪里。
lines.en: My fur smokes; I plunge into the surf.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的背，白毛卷成黑团。
lines.en: Fire sweeps my back and my white fur curls black.

lines.zh: 从礁石上滑下去，摔得四脚朝天。
lines.en: I slide off the reef and land on my back.

lines.zh: 我从礁上滑下，沙子灌进耳朵。
lines.en: I slide off the reef and sand pours into my ears.

lines.zh: 浪把我压下去，我抓不住沙。
lines.en: A wave pins me under; I cannot grip the sand.

lines.zh: 水下待太久，肺要炸了。
lines.en: Too long under, and my lungs will burst.

lines.zh: 炸起来的沙糊了我一脸。
lines.en: The blast throws sand into my face.

lines.zh: 一声炸响，我跌进浅水里。
lines.en: A blast knocks me into the shallows.

lines.zh: 箭插进厚毛里，只进了半截。
lines.en: The arrow sinks halfway into thick fur.

lines.zh: 海熊的皮，箭也扎不进去。
lines.en: Arrows don't pierce a sea bear's hide.

lines.zh: 那股味道让我想起单簧管，很不舒服。
lines.en: That tang reminds me of a clarinet. Unpleasant.

lines.zh: 紫光缠住我的鳍，游不动了。
lines.en: Purple light binds my fins, and I can't swim.

lines.zh: 滩上没鱼了，我饿得发慌。
lines.en: No fish left on this beach, and I am restless.

lines.zh: 饿得连竖笛都吹不动。
lines.en: Too hungry to even play a flute.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面上，我全身的毛都立起来。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and every hair rises.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，海水都跟着麻。
lines.en: The bolt lands and the seawater goes numb.

lines.zh: 脚下没有沙，只有往下掉的风。
lines.en: No sand underfoot, only falling wind.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有海，我不该来。
lines.en: No sea in the void. I shouldn't be here.
